about: The delimiters the HUD writes around the numbers beside its bars (HP[50/114]), for learning the glyphs it draws them in. Whatever a labeller took a delimiter for (the OCR engine read the classic HUD's opening bracket as a t, a dot, a colon and a quote), the glyph before a value is learned as "open" and the one after it as "close": one glyph is always one character to the font. "also": the other characters labellers write for them, which a line may be tried without, like these.
